_note: PLACEHOLDER dialogue. Only names and beats from the README are canon. Replace lines with approved chapter text.

intro.speaker: Sugo
lines: Today the bells ring for every child in Aramori.
But first... just one look past the fence. Nobody will notice.

beyond_fence.speaker: Sugo
lines: So this is what's out here.
...I should get back before the ceremony starts.

elder_before.speaker: Village Elder
lines: The ceremony begins soon, child. Don't wander off.

elder_return.speaker: Village Elder
lines: There you are, Sugo. Dust on your boots again.
Stand before the tower with the others. The Heavenly Way will answer.

elder_after.speaker: Village Elder
lines: Silence is also an answer, Sugo. We will learn what it means.

acolyte_before.speaker: Church Acolyte
lines: Every child is known to Heaven. Every child will be called.

acolyte_after.speaker: Church Acolyte
lines: The Church has words for children like you. Come to the Examination on the south road.
If Heaven will not claim you, perhaps your hands will speak instead.

acolyte_exam.speaker: Church Acolyte
lines: The south road, unclaimed one. The Examination waits.

child_a.speaker: Village Child
lines: I hope I get fire! Fire is the best.

child_b.speaker: Village Child
lines: My brother got his bell last year. He says it hums in your chest.

child_c.speaker: Village Child
lines: What if no bell rings for me?

mother.speaker: Villager
lines: Stand up straight at the ceremony, Sugo. The whole village is watching.
